question: What is the pitch MTNN's seed-to-seed noise floor, and does the shipped 'beats PCA(3) on 4/4 metrics' verdict survive it?
why_this_did_not_exist_before: SEED was a module constant with no flag, so every experiment ever run against this trainer was one seed against one seed. vector-pitch 38d68f4 added --seed and threaded it through all seven stochastic steps. This is the first seed sweep this model has ever had.
how_it_was_run: 5 seeds x 11 leave-one-context-out folds, in an ISOLATED COPY of the repo at a scratch path. The real trainer writes assets/pitch_mtnn_embeddings.json, the embedding dumbmodel.com cites, so the copy was checksummed against the real asset before and after: 88002e0d75ca012d both times, UNTOUCHED. ~551s per seed on the 4080.

flag_is_not_vacuous.note: Verified by running, not by inspection. The commit that added the flag said verified-by-inspection-only and this is the check it deferred.

THREE_OF_FOUR_PCA3_BASELINES_ARE_EXACTLY.why_the_fourth_moves: pos_cluster_acc is SCORED by k-means, and 38d68f4 threaded the seed into the evaluation clustering as well as the model. That is correct -- a seed sweep should move everything the reported number depends on -- but it has a consequence worth stating: on that one metric 'MTNN beats PCA(3)' compares two noisy numbers, while on the other three it compares a noisy number to a fixed one. Different comparisons, different floors.

shipped_verdict_survives.verdict: STABLE. 4 of 4 on all five seeds.

BUT_IT_LOSES_TO_PCA16.reading: The shipped claim is 'beats the SHIPPED PCA(3) baseline', and that is true and now seed-verified. It is not 'beats a linear baseline'. PCA(16) is computed by the same script, printed in the same summary, and beats the 24-d MTNN on knn5 role accuracy by 0.0375 (0 of 5 seeds, 4.2x the paired MDE) and on NN role coherence by 0.0187 (0 of 5 seeds, 3.0x). On pos-cluster accuracy the two are indistinguishable at this n. A reader who takes '4/4' as 'the neural model is the better embedding' would be wrong; what it means is 'better than the 3-component baseline that shipped'.

how_to_use_this: Any future pitch A/B must clear the paired MDE for the metric it moves, using sd OF DIFFERENCES across shared seeds -- not the per-arm sd, which is roughly 7x looser here. Do not size a paired experiment with the unpaired formula; that error was made and corrected in vector-hoops/pipeline/seed_floor.json CORRECTION_paired_floor.
